Select your substrate

Flute direction matters: vertical flutes are required if you’re using standard Wire H-stakes. Horizontal flutes are recommended when attaching signs to wooden stakes, zip-tying them to fences, or mounting them to trees or poles, as they provide more rigidity and reduce bending. Choosing the correct flute orientation ensures your corrugated plastic signs display properly and hold up in outdoor conditions.
